_comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Each entry needs a reason and a review date; after that date the check fails again. The security check reports these as ACCEPTED, never as passed.

advisories.reason: The flaw needs a caller-supplied output buffer (v3/v5/v6 with buf). exceljs only calls uuid.v4() with no arguments (lib/xlsx/xform/sheet/cf-ext/cf-rule-ext-xform.js), so it is not reachable. npm's suggested fix downgrades exceljs to 3.4.0.
